subject: proj
title: PROJ.------C.INFO.
description: First of two diagrams in JR-13 (Jazz-Rock). The prose immediately above identifies the structural target: 'To understand the reality implications of jazz-rock, it would be to our advantage to better understand the position of composite western creativity (from every so-called persuasion) with regard to the dynamic vibrational complications of its aesthetic — as a means to establish a basis for probing into the secrets of this projection.' The crossing diagrams how projection structurally meets composite-information at the jazz-rock-aesthetic-secrets scale: PROJ (projection — the form's actual projecting working) crossed with C-INFO (composite information). PROJ sits at lower-right with the subject-arrow, and its main line runs up-left to C-INFO at upper-left as partner-axis. INFO-DE(B) (information degrees, or information degree basis) at top-center rises from the main line and carries IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics) at upper-right, from whose line (R)INTR (the reality of interpretation) drops. EXT-FT (extended functionalism) branches from the main line to the right; SCI-DY (scientific dynamics) rises from EXT-FT's line, MTH (methodology) branches from SCI-DY's line, and LANG-DY (language dynamics) at the right margin from MTH's line. SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) at left-center branches from the main line and carries OIA, from whose line C-RH (composite research) at lower-left and EXB-H-OR (establishing high order) branch.
